chunks.sanskrit: yasya̠ dvārā̠ manu̍ṣpi̠tā de̠veṣu̠ dhiya̍ āna̠je || 1 ||
sa vi̠dvām̐ aṅgi̍robhya̠ indro̠ gā a̍vṛṇo̠dapa̍ |
sa pra̠tnathā̎ kavivṛ̠dha indro̎ vā̠kasya̍ va̠kṣaṇiḥ̍ |
ādū̠ nu te̠ anu̠ kratuṃ̠ svāhā̠ vara̍sya̠ yajya̍vaḥ |
indre̠ viśvā̎ni vī̠ryā̎ kṛ̠tāni̠ kartvā̎ni ca |
a̠sya vṛṣṇo̠ vyoda̍na u̠ru kra̍miṣṭa jī̠vase̎ |
a̠sme ru̠drā me̠hanā̠ parva̍tāso vṛtra̠hatye̠ bhara̍hūtau sa̠joṣāḥ̎ |
yaḥ śaṃsa̍te stuva̠te dhāyi̍ pa̠jra indra̍jyeṣṭhā a̠smām̐ a̍vantu de̠vāḥ || 12 ||
ut tvā̎ mandantu̠ stomāḥ̎ kṛṇu̠ṣva rādho̎ adrivaḥ |
pa̠dā pa̠ṇīm̐ra̍rā̠dhaso̠ ni bā̎dhasva ma̠hām̐ a̍si |
tyaṃ ci̠t parva̍taṃ gi̠riṃ śa̠tava̎ntaṃ saha̠sriṇa̎m |
va̠yamu̍ tvā̠ divā̎ su̠te va̠yaṃ naktaṃ̎ havāmahe |
kva1̍(a̠) sya vṛ̍ṣa̠bho yuvā̎ tuvi̠grīvo̠ anā̎nataḥ |
kasya̍ svi̠t sava̍naṃ̠ vṛṣā̎ juju̠ṣvām̐ ava̍ gacchati |
kaṃ te̎ dā̠nā a̍sakṣata̠ vṛtra̍ha̠n kaṃ su̠vīryā̎ |
a̠yaṃ te̠ mānu̍ṣe̠ jane̠ somaḥ̍ pū̠ruṣu̍ sūyate |
tama̠dya rādha̍se ma̠he cāruṃ̠ madā̎ya̠ ghṛṣva̍ye |
ā tvā̎ gī̠rbhirma̠hāmu̠ruṃ hu̠ve gāmi̍va̠ bhoja̍se |
ā ta̍ indra mahi̠mānaṃ̠ hara̍yo deva te̠ mahaḥ̍ |
indra̍ gṛṇī̠ṣa u̍ stu̠ṣe ma̠hām̐ u̠gra ī̎śāna̠kṛt |
bṛ̠hadgāya̎ntaḥ su̠taso̎me adhva̠re hu̠ve bharaṃ̠ na kā̠riṇa̎m || 1 ||
na yaṃ du̠dhrā vara̎nte̠ na sthi̠rā muro̠ made̎ suśi̠pramandha̍saḥ |
ya ā̠dṛtyā̎ śaśamā̠nāya̍ sunva̠te dātā̎ jari̠tra u̠kthya̎m || 2 ||
yaḥ śa̠kro mṛ̠kṣo aśvyo̠ yo vā̠ kījo̎ hira̠ṇyayaḥ̍ |
va̠jrī su̍śi̠pro harya̍śva̠ it ka̍ra̠dindraḥ̠ kratvā̠ yathā̠ vaśa̍t || 4 ||
va̠yaṃ tat ta̍ indra̠ saṃ bha̍rāmasi ya̠jñamu̠kthaṃ tu̠raṃ vacaḥ̍ || 5 ||
sacā̠ some̎ṣu puruhūta vajrivo̠ madā̎ya dyukṣa somapāḥ |
tvamiddhi bra̎hma̠kṛte̠ kāmyaṃ̠ vasu̠ deṣṭhaḥ̍ sunva̠te bhuvaḥ̍ || 6 ||
tasmā̎ u a̠dya sa̍ma̠nā su̠taṃ bha̠rā '' nū̠naṃ bhū̎ṣata śru̠te || 7 ||
semaṃ naḥ̠ stomaṃ̎ jujuṣā̠ṇa ā ga̠hīndra̠ pra ci̠trayā̎ dhi̠yā || 8 ||
keno̠ nu kaṃ̠ śroma̍tena̠ na śu̍śruve ja̠nuṣaḥ̠ pari̍ vṛtra̠hā || 9 ||
kadū̎ ma̠hīradhṛ̍ṣṭā asya̠ tavi̍ṣīḥ̠ kadu̍ vṛtra̠ghno astṛ̍tam |
indro̠ viśvā̎n beka̠nāṭām̐̎ aha̠rdṛśa̍ u̠ta kratvā̎ pa̠ṇīm̐ra̠bhi || 10 ||
va̠yaṃ ghā̎ te̠ apū̠rvyendra̠ brahmā̎ṇi vṛtrahan |
pu̠rū̠tamā̎saḥ puruhūta vajrivo bhṛ̠tiṃ na pra bha̍rāmasi || 11 ||
ti̠raści̍da̠ryaḥ sava̠nā va̍so gahi̠ śavi̍ṣṭha śru̠dhi me̠ hava̎m || 12 ||
va̠yaṃ ghā̎ te̠ tve idvindra̠ viprā̠ api̍ ṣmasi |
na̠hi tvada̠nyaḥ pu̍ruhūta̠ kaśca̠na magha̍va̠nnasti̍ marḍi̠tā || 13 ||
tvaṃ no̎ a̠syā ama̍teru̠ta kṣu̠dho̠3̍(o̠) 'bhiśa̍ste̠rava̍ spṛdhi |
tvaṃ na̍ ū̠tī tava̍ ci̠trayā̎ dhi̠yā śikṣā̎ śaciṣṭha gātu̠vit || 14 ||
soma̠ idvaḥ̍ su̠to a̍stu̠ kala̍yo̠ mā bi̍bhītana |
tyān nu kṣa̠triyām̠̐ ava̍ ādi̠tyān yā̎ciṣāmahe |
mā naḥ̠ setuḥ̍ siṣeda̠yaṃ ma̠he vṛ̍ṇaktu na̠spari̍ |
parṣi̍ dī̠ne ga̍bhī̠ra ām̐ ugra̍putre̠ jighāṃ̎sataḥ |
a̠ne̠ho na̍ uruvraja̠ urū̎ci̠ vi prasa̍rtave |
apo̠ ṣu ṇa̍ i̠yaṃ śaru̠rādi̍tyā̠ apa̍ durma̠tiḥ |
tatsu no̠ navyaṃ̠ sanya̍sa̠ ādi̍tyā̠ yanmumo̎cati |
mā no̎ he̠tirvi̠vasva̍ta̠ ādi̍tyāḥ kṛ̠trimā̠ śaruḥ̍ |
vi ṣu dveṣo̠ vyaṃ̎ha̠timādi̍tyāso̠ vi saṃhi̍tam |
ā tvā̠ rathaṃ̠ yatho̠taye̎ su̠mnāya̍ vartayāmasi |
yasya̍ te mahi̠nā ma̠haḥ pari̍ jmā̠yanta̍mī̠yatuḥ̍ |
na yasya̍ te śavasāna sa̠khyamā̠naṃśa̠ martyaḥ̍ |
yasya̍ te svā̠du sa̠khyaṃ svā̠dvī praṇī̎tiradrivaḥ |
u̠ru ṇa̍sta̠nve̠3̍(e̠) tana̍ u̠ru kṣayā̎ya naskṛdhi |
u̠ruṃ nṛbhya̍ u̠ruṃ gava̍ u̠ruṃ rathā̎ya̠ panthā̎m |
upa̍ mā̠ ṣaḍ dvādvā̠ naraḥ̠ soma̍sya̠ harṣyā̎ |
ṛ̠jrāvi̎ndro̠ta ā da̍de̠ harī̠ ṛkṣa̍sya sū̠navi̍ |
tā a̍sya̠ sūda̍dohasaḥ̠ somaṃ̎ śrīṇanti̠ pṛśna̍yaḥ |
a̠bhi pra gopa̍tiṃ gi̠rendra̍marca̠ yathā̎ vi̠de |
indrā̎ya̠ gāva̍ ā̠śiraṃ̎ dudu̠hre va̠jriṇe̠ madhu̍ |
madhvaḥ̍ pī̠tvā sa̍cevahi̠ triḥ sa̠pta sakhyuḥ̍ pa̠de || 7 ||
arca̎ntu putra̠kā u̠ta puraṃ̠ na dhṛ̠ṣṇva̍rcata || 8 ||
ava̍ svarāti̠ garga̍ro go̠dhā pari̍ saniṣvaṇat |
varu̍ṇa̠ idi̠ha kṣa̍ya̠t tamāpo̎ a̠bhya̍nūṣata va̠tsaṃ saṃ̠śiśva̍rīriva || 11 ||
su̠de̠vo a̍si varuṇa̠ yasya̍ te sa̠pta sindha̍vaḥ |
atīdu̍ śa̠kra o̎hata̠ indro̠ viśvā̠ ati̠ dviṣaḥ̍ |
bhi̠nat ka̠nīna̍ oda̠naṃ pa̠cyamā̎naṃ pa̠ro gi̠rā || 14 ||
a̠rbha̠ko na ku̍māra̠ko 'dhi̍ tiṣṭha̠n navaṃ̠ ratha̎m |
sa pa̍kṣanmahi̠ṣaṃ mṛ̠gaṃ pi̠tre mā̠tre vi̍bhu̠kratu̎m || 15 ||
ā tū su̍śipra dampate̠ rathaṃ̎ tiṣṭhā hira̠ṇyaya̎m |
arthaṃ̎ cidasya̠ sudhi̍taṃ̠ yadeta̍va āva̠rtaya̎nti dā̠vane̎ || 17 ||
viśvā̎sāṃ taru̠tā pṛta̍nānāṃ̠ jyeṣṭho̠ yo vṛ̍tra̠hā gṛ̠ṇe || 1 ||
indraṃ̠ taṃ śu̎mbha puruhanma̠nnava̍se̠ yasya̍ dvi̠tā vi̍dha̠rtari̍ |
hastā̎ya̠ vajraḥ̠ prati̍ dhāyi darśa̠to ma̠ho di̠ve na sūryaḥ̍ || 2 ||
saṃ dhe̠navo̠ jāya̍māne anonavu̠rdyāvaḥ̠ kṣāmo̎ anonavuḥ || 4 ||
yaddyāva̍ indra te śa̠taṃ śa̠taṃ bhūmī̎ru̠ta syuḥ |
na tvā̎ vajrin tsa̠hasraṃ̠ sūryā̠ anu̠ na jā̠tama̍ṣṭa̠ roda̍sī || 5 ||
ā pa̍prātha mahi̠nā vṛṣṇyā̎ vṛṣa̠n viśvā̎ śaviṣṭha̠ śava̍sā |
a̠smām̐ a̍va maghava̠n goma̍ti vra̠je vajri̎ñci̠trābhi̍rū̠tibhiḥ̍ || 6 ||
eta̍gvā ci̠dya eta̍śā yu̠yoja̍te̠ harī̠ indro̎ yu̠yoja̍te || 7 ||
taṃ vo̎ ma̠ho ma̠hāyya̠mindraṃ̎ dā̠nāya̍ sa̠kṣaṇi̎m |
yo gā̠dheṣu̠ ya āra̍ṇeṣu̠ havyo̠ vāje̠ṣvasti̠ havyaḥ̍ || 8 ||
udū̠ ṣu ṇo̎ vaso ma̠he mṛ̠śasva̍ śūra̠ rādha̍se |
udū̠ ṣu ma̠hyai ma̍ghavan ma̠ghatta̍ya̠ udi̎ndra̠ śrava̍se ma̠he || 9 ||
tvaṃ na̍ indra ṛta̠yustvā̠nido̠ ni tṛ̎mpasi |
madhye̎ vasiṣva tuvinṛmṇo̠rvorni dā̠saṃ śi̍śnatho̠ hathaiḥ̎ || 10 ||
ava̠ svaḥ sakhā̎ dudhuvīta̠ parva̍taḥ su̠ghnāya̠ dasyuṃ̠ parva̍taḥ || 11 ||
tvaṃ na̍ indrāsāṃ̠ haste̎ śaviṣṭha dā̠vane̎ |
dhā̠nānāṃ̠ na saṃ gṛ̍bhāyāsma̠yurdviḥ saṃ gṛ̍bhāyāsma̠yuḥ || 12 ||
ka̠rṇa̠gṛhyā̎ ma̠ghavā̎ śaurade̠vyo va̠tsaṃ na̍stri̠bhya āna̍yat |
tvaṃ no̎ agne̠ maho̎bhiḥ pā̠hi viśva̍syā̠ arā̎teḥ |
na̠hi ma̠nyuḥ pauru̍ṣeya̠ īśe̠ hi vaḥ̍ priyajāta |
na tama̍gne̠ arā̎tayo̠ martaṃ̎ yuvanta rā̠yaḥ |
yaṃ tvaṃ vi̍pra me̠dhasā̎tā̠vagne̎ hi̠noṣi̠ dhanā̎ya |
u̠ru̠ṣyā ṇo̠ mā parā̎ dā aghāya̠te jā̎tavedaḥ |
sa no̠ vasva̠ upa̍ mā̠syūrjo̎ napā̠nmāhi̍nasya |
acchā̎ naḥ śī̠raśo̎ciṣaṃ̠ giro̎ yantu darśa̠tam |
a̠gniṃ sū̠nuṃ saha̍so jā̠tave̎dasaṃ dā̠nāya̠ vāryā̎ṇām |
dvi̠tā yo bhūda̠mṛto̠ martye̠ṣvā hotā̎ ma̠ndrata̍mo vi̠śi || 11 ||
a̠gniri̠ṣāṃ sa̠khye da̍dātu na̠ īśe̠ yo vāryā̎ṇām |
a̠gniṃ to̠ke tana̍ye̠ śaśva̍dīmahe̠ vasuṃ̠ santaṃ̎ tanū̠pām || 13 ||
a̠gniṃ rā̠ye pu̍rumīḷha śru̠taṃ naro̠ 'gniṃ su̍dī̠taye̎ cha̠rdiḥ || 14 ||
a̠gniṃ dveṣo̠ yota̠vai no̎ gṛṇīmasya̠gniṃ śaṃ yośca̠ dāta̍ve |
a̠ntari̍cchanti̠ taṃ jane̎ ru̠draṃ pa̠ro ma̍nī̠ṣayā̎ |
cara̎n va̠tso ruśa̎nni̠ha ni̍dā̠tāraṃ̠ na vi̎ndate |
te jā̎nata̠ svamo̠kya1̍(aṃ̠) saṃ va̠tsāso̠ na mā̠tṛbhiḥ̍ |
upa̠ srakve̎ṣu̠ bapsa̍taḥ kṛṇva̠te dha̠ruṇaṃ̎ di̠vi |
u̠to nva̍sya̠ yat pa̠daṃ ha̎rya̠tasya̍ nidhā̠nya̎m |
kuha̍ sthaḥ̠ kuha̍ jagmathuḥ̠ kuha̍ śye̠neva̍ petathuḥ |
i̠hā ga̍taṃ vṛṣaṇvasū śṛṇu̠taṃ ma̍ i̠maṃ hava̎m |
yo vāṃ̠ rajāṃ̎syaśvinā̠ ratho̎ vi̠yāti̠ roda̍sī |
puraṃ̠ na dhṛ̍ṣṇa̠vā ru̍ja kṛ̠ṣṇayā̎ bādhi̠to vi̠śā |
a̠gniṃ vo̠ duryaṃ̠ vacaḥ̍ stu̠ṣe śū̠ṣasya̠ manma̍bhiḥ || 1 ||
yaṃ janā̎so ha̠viṣma̎nto mi̠traṃ na sa̠rpirā̎sutim |
sā te̎ agne̠ śaṃta̍mā̠ cani̍ṣṭhā bhavatu pri̠yā |
yasya̠ śravāṃ̎si̠ tūrva̍tha̠ panya̎mpanyaṃ ca kṛ̠ṣṭayaḥ̍ || 10 ||
yaṃ tvā̎ go̠pava̍no gi̠rā cani̍ṣṭhadagne aṅgiraḥ |
yaṃ tvā̠ janā̎sa̠ īḷa̍te sa̠bādho̠ vāja̍sātaye |
su̠rathā̎so a̠bhi prayo̠ vakṣa̠n vayo̠ na tugrya̎m || 14 ||
yu̠kṣvā hi de̎va̠hūta̍mām̠̐ aśvām̐̎ agne ra̠thīri̍va |
u̠ta no̎ deva de̠vām̐ acchā̎ voco vi̠duṣṭa̍raḥ |
mā naḥ̍ samasya dū̠ḍhya1̍(aḥ̠) pari̍dveṣaso aṃha̠tiḥ |
nama̍ste agna̠ oja̍se gṛ̠ṇanti̍ deva kṛ̠ṣṭayaḥ̍ |
ku̠vit su no̠ gavi̍ṣṭa̠ye 'gne̎ saṃ̠veṣi̍ṣo ra̠yim |
mā no̎ a̠smin ma̍hādha̠ne parā̎ vargbhāra̠bhṛdya̍thā |
vi̠dmā hi te̎ pu̠rā va̠yamagne̎ pi̠turyathāva̍saḥ |
a̠yaṃ ha̠ yena̠ vā i̠daṃ sva̎rma̠rutva̍tā ji̠tam |
ma̠rutvām̐̎ indra mīḍhvaḥ̠ pibā̠ somaṃ̎ śatakrato |
tena̍ sto̠tṛbhya̠ ā bha̍ra̠ nṛbhyo̠ nāri̍bhyo̠ atta̍ve |
e̠tā cyau̠tnāni̍ te kṛ̠tā varṣi̍ṣṭhāni̠ parī̎ṇasā |
tu̠vi̠kṣaṃ te̠ sukṛ̍taṃ sū̠mayaṃ̠ dhanuḥ̍ sā̠dhurbu̠ndo hi̍ra̠ṇyayaḥ̍ |
u̠bhā te̎ bā̠hū raṇyā̠ susaṃ̎skṛta ṛdū̠pe ci̍dṛdū̠vṛdhā̎ || 11 ||
pu̠ro̠ḷāśaṃ̎ no̠ andha̍sa̠ indra̍ sa̠hasra̠mā bha̍ra |
u̠ta naḥ̍ karṇa̠śobha̍nā pu̠rūṇi̍ dhṛṣṇa̠vā bha̍ra |
nakīṃ̎ vṛdhī̠ka i̎ndra te̠ na su̠ṣā na su̠dā u̠ta |
tve vasū̎ni̠ saṃga̍tā̠ viśvā̎ ca soma̠ saubha̍gā |
di̠nasya̍ vā maghava̠n tsambhṛ̍tasya vā pū̠rdhi yava̍sya kā̠śinā̎ || 10 ||
tvaṃ ci̠ttī tava̠ dakṣai̎rdi̠va ā pṛ̍thi̠vyā ṛ̍jīṣin |
mā naḥ̍ soma̠ saṃ vī̎vijo̠ mā vi bī̎bhiṣathā rājan |
rāja̠nnapa̠ dviṣaḥ̍ sedha̠ mīḍhvo̠ apa̠ sridhaḥ̍ sedha || 9 ||
hanto̠ nu kimā̎sase pratha̠maṃ no̠ rathaṃ̎ kṛdhi |
avā̎ no vāja̠yuṃ rathaṃ̎ su̠karaṃ̎ te̠ kimitpari̍ |
indra̠ dṛhya̍sva̠ pūra̍si bha̠drā ta̍ eti niṣkṛ̠tam |
mā sī̎mava̠dya ā bhā̎gu̠rvī kāṣṭhā̎ hi̠taṃ dhana̎m |
avī̎vṛdhadvo amṛtā̠ ama̎ndīdeka̠dyūrde̎vā u̠ta yāśca̍ devīḥ |
tasmā̎ u̠ rādhaḥ̍ kṛṇuta praśa̠staṃ prā̠tarma̠kṣū dhi̠yāva̍surjagamyāt || 10 ||
ā tū na̍ indra kṣu̠mantaṃ̎ ci̠traṃ grā̠bhaṃ saṃ gṛ̍bhāya |
vi̠dmā hi tvā̎ tuvikū̠rmiṃ tu̠vide̎ṣṇaṃ tu̠vīma̍gham |
na̠hi tvā̎ śūra de̠vā na martā̎so̠ ditsa̎ntam |
ā no̎ bhara̠ dakṣi̍ṇenā̠bhi sa̠vyena̠ pra mṛ̍śa |
upa̍ krama̠svā bha̍ra dhṛṣa̠tā dhṛ̍ṣṇo̠ janā̎nām |
indra̠ ya u̠ nu te̠ asti̠ vājo̠ vipre̎bhiḥ̠ sani̍tvaḥ |
tī̠vrāḥ somā̎sa̠ ā ga̍hi su̠tāso̎ mādayi̠ṣṇavaḥ̍ |
ā tva̍śatra̠vā ga̍hi̠ nyu1̍(u̠)kthāni̍ ca hūyase |
tubhyā̠yamadri̍bhiḥ su̠to gobhiḥ̍ śrī̠to madā̎ya̠ kam |
indra̍ śru̠dhi su me̠ hava̍ma̠sme su̠tasya̠ goma̍taḥ |
ya i̎ndra cama̠seṣvā soma̍śca̠mūṣu̍ te su̠taḥ |
yo a̠psu ca̠ndramā̎ iva̠ soma̍śca̠mūṣu̠ dadṛ̍śe |
te naḥ̍ santu̠ yujaḥ̠ sadā̠ varu̍ṇo mi̠tro a̎rya̠mā |
ati̍ no viṣpi̠tā pu̠ru nau̠bhira̠po na pa̍rṣatha |
yū̠yaṃ hi ṣṭhā su̍dānava̠ indra̍jyeṣṭhā a̠bhidya̍vaḥ |
preṣṭhaṃ̎ vo̠ ati̍thiṃ stu̠ṣe mi̠trami̍va pri̠yam |
ka̠vimi̍va̠ prace̎tasaṃ̠ yaṃ de̠vāso̠ adha̍ dvi̠tā |
tvaṃ ya̍viṣṭha dā̠śuṣo̠ nṝm̐ḥ pā̎hi śṛṇu̠dhī giraḥ̍ |
kayā̎ te agne aṅgira̠ ūrjo̎ napā̠dupa̍stutim |
dāśe̎ma̠ kasya̠ mana̍sā ya̠jñasya̍ sahaso yaho |
adhā̠ tvaṃ hi na̠skaro̠ viśvā̎ a̠smabhyaṃ̎ sukṣi̠tīḥ |
kasya̍ nū̠naṃ parī̎ṇaso̠ dhiyo̎ jinvasi dampate |
kṣeti̠ kṣeme̎bhiḥ sā̠dhubhi̠rnaki̠ryaṃ ghnanti̠ hanti̠ yaḥ |
ā me̠ havaṃ̎ nāsa̠tyāśvi̍nā̠ gaccha̍taṃ yu̠vam |
i̠maṃ me̠ stoma̍maśvine̠maṃ me̎ śṛṇutaṃ̠ hava̎m |
a̠yaṃ vāṃ̠ kṛṣṇo̎ aśvinā̠ hava̍te vājinīvasū |
nū me̠ giro̎ nāsa̠tyāśvi̍nā̠ prāva̍taṃ yu̠vam |
u̠bhā hi da̠srā bhi̠ṣajā̎ mayo̠bhuvo̠bhā dakṣa̍sya̠ vaca̍so babhū̠vathuḥ̍ |
tā vāṃ̠ viśva̍ko havate tanūkṛ̠the mā no̠ vi yau̎ṣṭaṃ sa̠khyā mu̠moca̍tam || 1 ||
ka̠thā nū̠naṃ vāṃ̠ vima̍nā̠ upa̍ stavadyu̠vaṃ dhiyaṃ̎ dadathu̠rvasya̍iṣṭaye |
tā vāṃ̠ viśva̍ko havate tanūkṛ̠the mā no̠ vi yau̎ṣṭaṃ sa̠khyā mu̠moca̍tam || 2 ||
yu̠vaṃ hi ṣmā̎ purubhuje̠mame̎dha̠tuṃ vi̍ṣṇā̠pve̎ da̠dathu̠rvasya̍iṣṭaye |
tā vāṃ̠ viśva̍ko havate tanūkṛ̠the mā no̠ vi yau̎ṣṭaṃ sa̠khyā mu̠moca̍tam || 3 ||
u̠ta tyaṃ vī̠raṃ dha̍na̠sāmṛ̍jī̠ṣiṇaṃ̎ dū̠re ci̠tsanta̠mava̍se havāmahe |
yasya̠ svādi̍ṣṭhā suma̠tiḥ pi̠turya̍thā̠ mā no̠ vi yau̎ṣṭaṃ sa̠khyā mu̠moca̍tam || 4 ||
ṛ̠tena̍ de̠vaḥ sa̍vi̠tā śa̍māyata ṛ̠tasya̠ śṛṅga̍murvi̠yā vi pa̍prathe |
ṛ̠taṃ sā̎sāha̠ mahi̍ cit pṛtanya̠to mā no̠ vi yau̎ṣṭaṃ sa̠khyā mu̠moca̍tam || 5 ||
dyu̠mnī vāṃ̠ stomo̎ aśvinā̠ krivi̠rna seka̠ ā ga̍tam |
madhvaḥ̍ su̠tasya̠ sa di̠vi pri̠yo na̍rā pā̠taṃ gau̠rāvi̠veri̍ṇe || 1 ||
piba̍taṃ gha̠rmaṃ madhu̍mantamaśvi̠nā ba̠rhiḥ sī̎dataṃ narā |
tā ma̎ndasā̠nā manu̍ṣo duro̠ṇa ā ni pā̎taṃ̠ veda̍sā̠ vayaḥ̍ || 2 ||
tā va̠rtiryā̎ta̠mupa̍ vṛ̠ktaba̎rhiṣo̠ juṣṭaṃ̎ ya̠jñaṃ divi̍ṣṭiṣu || 3 ||
piba̍taṃ̠ somaṃ̠ madhu̍mantamaśvi̠nā ba̠rhiḥ sī̎dataṃ su̠mat |
tā vā̎vṛdhā̠nā upa̍ suṣṭu̠tiṃ di̠vo ga̠ntaṃ gau̠rāvi̠veri̍ṇam || 4 ||
va̠yaṃ hi vāṃ̠ havā̎mahe vipa̠nyavo̠ viprā̎so̠ vāja̍sātaye |
tā va̠lgū da̠srā pu̍ru̠daṃsa̍sā dhi̠yāśvi̍nā śru̠ṣṭyā ga̍tam || 6 ||
a̠bhi va̠tsaṃ na svasa̍reṣu dhe̠nava̠ indraṃ̎ gī̠rbhirna̍vāmahe || 1 ||
dyu̠kṣaṃ su̠dānuṃ̠ tavi̍ṣībhi̠rāvṛ̍taṃ gi̠riṃ na pu̍ru̠bhoja̍sam |
kṣu̠mantaṃ̠ vājaṃ̎ śa̠tinaṃ̎ saha̠sriṇaṃ̎ ma̠kṣū goma̎ntamīmahe || 2 ||
na tvā̎ bṛ̠hanto̠ adra̍yo̠ vara̎nta indra vī̠ḷavaḥ̍ |
yadditsa̍si stuva̠te māva̍te̠ vasu̠ naki̠ṣṭadā mi̍nāti te || 3 ||
yoddhā̎si̠ kratvā̠ śava̍so̠ta daṃ̠sanā̠ viśvā̎ jā̠tābhi ma̠jmanā̎ |
ā tvā̠yama̠rka ū̠taye̎ vavartati̠ yaṃ gota̍mā̠ ajī̎janan || 4 ||
pra hi ri̍ri̠kṣa oja̍sā di̠vo ante̎bhya̠spari̍ |
na tvā̎ vivyāca̠ raja̍ indra̠ pārthi̍va̠manu̍ sva̠dhāṃ va̍vakṣitha || 5 ||
